concerns.text: T017c is marked as incomplete (`- [ ]`) despite FR-001 mandating the generation of 10,000 matrices. The task description claims to enforce the count, but the incomplete status means the deliverable (the dataset) is missing, blocking all downstream US2/US3 tasks. This is a semantic weakening of the FR-001 requirement to 'generate' data.

T009_calc is marked as incomplete (`- [ ]`). FR-008 and SC-002 explicitly require computing a theoretical lower bound to avoid circular validation. Without this task's completion, the validation of the static prior against an independent ground truth is impossible, violating the spec's core methodological constraint.

T042 (Latency Profiling) is a separate, incomplete task (`- [ ]`) from the simulation runner T027d. FR-005 requires profiling wall-clock time per token. If T042 is not integrated into T027d's execution path, the simulation will not produce the required latency metrics, effectively weakening FR-005 to 'optional' or 'post-hoc'.

T005a (Sensitivity Analysis) is a separate, incomplete task (`- [ ]`) from the batch runner T030b. FR-007 requires sweeping epsilon values during the simulation. If T005a is not integrated into the loop, the system cannot report the variation rate across the sweep, violating the FR-007 requirement for a dynamic sensitivity analysis.

T049 is a 'Revision' task to fix data flow, but the current task list (Phase 5) has T030b (Execution) depending on T027d (Implementation) which is incomplete. This creates a circular dependency where the execution task cannot run because the implementation task is not done, violating the executability constraint of the plan.

T050 proposes merging T042 into T027d, but T042 is currently a separate incomplete task. This indicates the current task list fails to preserve the FR-005 constraint by not embedding latency profiling directly into the simulation loop, risking a 'silent relaxation' where latency is not measured.

T051 proposes merging T005a into T030b, but T005a is currently a separate incomplete task. This indicates the current task list fails to preserve the FR-007 constraint by not embedding the epsilon sweep into the batch runner, risking a 'silent relaxation' where sensitivity is not measured.
